answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake whose slashing curve is proven safe in TLA+, so a fake identity plume cannot outrun detection before its bond is forfeit. Colluding clusters that try to spiral into many pseudonyms trigger an inductive invariant capping total exposure, forcing attackers into a costly haven of diminishing returns. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
